s03A441.name: Bowser state 0: enter and start fight
summary: Bowser main routine state 0 ([$151C] = 0). Bowser descends from the top of the screen to line $10, pauses for [$1540] frames animating his face,
then sets [$154C] and switches to state 7 with the attack timer [$14B0] = $78. Ending at $03A482 is the state change itself.
Quirk: [$154C] is used here as a delay timer, not only for interaction.

s03A49C.name: Bowser state 7: hover and face Mario
summary: State 7 ([$151C] = 7): Bowser floats in a loop. X speed ramps between -$38 and +$38 and Y speed between -$1C and +$1C,
reversing direction each time the limit is reached. Also runs the face animation and attack scheduler.
$03A4D2: face animation. Frame counter bits 3-4 pick DATA_03A498 for 32 frames out of every 256, else face 0.

s03A4ED.name: Bowser: face Mario and attack scheduler
summary: $03A4ED: every 32 frames, sets Bowser's direction [$157C] so he looks at Mario.
$03A4FD: attack scheduler, run when the phase timer [$14B0] is 0. In state 8 it starts a Bowser Ball throw ([$14B6] = $FF) the first two times
(counted in [$14B8]) and then falls to the Mechakoopa drop: [$14B1] = $FF, only if sprite slot 0 or 1 is free.

s03A52D.name: Table: Bowser face frames for attacks
summary: Face frame [$1570] indexed by attack timer / 4 for both the Mechakoopa drop and the ball throw.

s03A56D.name: Table: Bowser tilt for ball throw
summary: [$36] values indexed by [$14B6] / 4. $FF means the high byte [$37] becomes 1 instead.

s03A5AD.name: Bowser: Mechakoopa drop and ball throw
summary: Called every frame from the main routine. If the Mechakoopa timer [$14B1] runs, animates the face and spawns a Mechakoopa (sprite $A2, CODE_03B019)
when it hits $80, then skips the rest of the main routine (PLA, PLA). Else if the ball timer [$14B6] runs, does the same and spawns a
Bowser Ball (sprite $A1) at timer $80. When a timer finishes it sets the next phase timer [$14B0].
$03A61D: spawn the Bowser Ball in slot 8 at Bowser X + 8, Y + $40.

s03A64D.name: Table: Bowser shake when hurt
summary: Signed X shake [$36] indexed by hurt timer [$14B5] / 4.

s03A661.name: Bowser: hurt reaction
summary: Called every frame. While the hurt timer [$14B5] runs, cancels attacks, shakes Bowser and flickers his face, then skips the rest of the main routine.
When it ends, decrements the hits-left counter [$187B]. At 0 Bowser goes to state 1 (retreat), or to state 4 if he was in state 9 (probably the defeat).

KillMostSprites.name: Kill all sprites except bosses
summary: Sets every sprite in slots 0-9 to status 4 (killed by spin jump) with a smoke timer of $1F, except Reznor ($A9), Koopa Kid ($29), Bowser ($A0)
and Big Boo Boss ($C5). Long call (RTL).

s03A6F0.name: Table: Bowser face frame in state 1

s03A6F8.name: Bowser state 1: shake then retreat
summary: State 1: while [$1540] counts down Bowser sits still with his face animated (music $17 when it reaches 1), then moves via CODE_03A731.

s03A71F.name: Table: Bowser retreat accelerations
summary: Pairs for the X, Y and scale stages of the retreat: steps, limits and frame masks.

s03A731.name: Bowser state 1: retreat off-screen
summary: Ramps X speed, Y speed and the scale [$38]/[$39] in two stages each. Once scale stage [$14B2] is 2, or Bowser's X high is $FE,
goes to state 3 with timer [$14B0] = $80, picks a random start for the falling objects and starts music $1D.

BowserSound.name: Table: Bowser sound effect (first entry)
summary: Sound effect values for $1DFC indexed by column / 32; it continues in the next label.

BowserSoundMusic.name: Bowser state 2 and music table
summary: $03A842: table of values indexed by [$14B4], written to $1DFB (music) at timer $3F; the first 8 bytes also serve as sound effects for BowserSound.
State 2 ($03A84B): Bowser slows, scales up to $20, drops a Super Mushroom at timer $A0, plays sound $2A at $E8 and at timer 1 switches to state [$14B4] + 1.

s03A8BE.name: Table: object vertical offset
summary: Offset subtracted from the drawn object's Y, indexed by [$1594] / 8.

s03A8D6.name: Spawn Super Mushroom from Bowser
summary: Finds a free sprite slot (7 down to 2), makes it a Super Mushroom (sprite $74) at Bowser X + 4, Y + $18, thrown upward ($C0) and sideways toward the screen center.

s03A92E.name: Table: X offsets for Bowser overlay tiles

s03A97E.name: Table: Y offsets for Bowser overlay tiles

s03A9CE.name: Table: tile numbers for Bowser overlay

s03AA1E.name: Table: tile properties for Bowser overlay

s03AA6E.name: Draw Bowser overlay (probably Peach)
summary: Draws a 2x2 group of 16x16 tiles at OAM $70 using the four tables above, indexed by [$03] * 4. Frames 8-15 of the animation also draw two extra
sprites at OAM $02A0/$02A4. Identification of the drawn object as Peach is a guess based on the tile data and the mushroom drop.
Parameters: Y: animation step, [$02]: vertical offset, [$03]: frame row.

s03AB15.name: Table: Bowser chase accelerations
summary: X and Y acceleration and speed limits for state 8. The last 4 bytes belong to another routine.

s03AB21.name: Bowser state 8: chase Mario
summary: State 8: runs the attack scheduler and face routines. Every frame, accelerates X toward Mario up to +/-$20, and Y toward screen line $10 at +/-$20.

s03AB62.name: Table: Bowser hop X speed
summary: X speed $10/-$10 by side of Mario (used by the next state).
